data.name: Walking Tour
data.headline: 2 Hours • Family Friendly! • All ages
data.description:
#Join us! 

##Duration					
2 Hours			

##About					
Discover the heart of Boston with us—Paul and Nick Bessa, a dedicated father-son duo passionate about our city’s rich tapestry of history. We’re not just guides; we’re storytellers and history buffs eager to share Boston’s legacy.					

##More info					
Our journey begins at Copp’s Hill Terrace, where the storied past of Boston’s North End comes to life. As we wander through the city’s oldest neighborhood, we’ll marvel at the waterfront views, delve into the tales of the USS Constitution, and stand where revolutionaries once did, gazing out at the Bunker Hill Monument.
